name: OpenProject MCP for Orca
description: Community-built Orca sidebar and Rust MCP integration for OpenProject CE, with guarded ticket writes.

cover.alt: Illustration of the OpenProject MCP for Orca ticket panel using synthetic demo tasks

statusBarItems.tooltip: OpenProject CE connection status (click to refresh)

settings.title: OpenProject Base URL
settings.description: Base URL of your OpenProject Community Edition instance (e.g. https://openproject.example.com).

settings.title: Read Projects Allowlist
settings.description: Comma-separated project identifiers or '*' allowed for reading (maps to OPENPROJECT_READ_PROJECTS).

settings.title: Write Projects Allowlist
settings.description: Comma-separated project identifiers or '*' allowed for guarded writes (maps to OPENPROJECT_WRITE_PROJECTS).

settings.title: Default Agent for Tickets
settings.description: Agent CLI to start when launching work on an OpenProject work package.

settings.title: Rust MCP Binary Path
settings.description: Executable name or path for the Rust mcp-openproject stdio server.

settings.title: Inject OpenProject Env on Agent Launch
settings.description: Automatically pass OPENPROJECT_BASE_URL, OPENPROJECT_API_TOKEN, and project allowlists to agents started in Orca.
